name: Renee & Chaim Gross Foundation
funding: New York State parks office $200,186 (facade, 2023), State Council on the Arts $55,000 (2023), National Trust for Historic Preservation $18,000, Preservation League $3,680, Robert David Lion Gardiner Foundation $10,500.

name: Frank Lloyd Wright Trust
funding: Tours and programs earn 58% of $5.5M income (2025). Funders include Illinois Arts Council, Institute of Museum and Library Services, JPMorgan Chase Foundation, Allstate, Google and Village of Oak Park.

name: The Gamble House
funding: The Conservancy raises gifts and endowments to run the city-owned house. The Annenberg Foundation gave operating support in 2022. A Getty Trust grant paid for its historic structure report.

name: Edith Farnsworth House
funding: The National Trust for Historic Preservation owns and runs it. Contributions were $69.3M of its $104.9M revenue in fiscal 2025. Benjamin Moore supports its stewardship.

name: Sunnylands
funding: The Annenberg Foundation Trust at Sunnylands owns and runs it on $691M in net assets and does no fundraising. Walter Annenberg's fortune came from Triangle Publications, sold in 1988.

name: Schweikher House
funding: Trust income $104,119 in the year to April 2025: contributions and grants $63,346, program services $40,143. Illinois Arts Council supports programming. The Village of Schaumburg is a named partner.

name: Marcel Breuer House at Pocantico
funding: The National Trust for Historic Preservation owns the house. The Rockefeller Brothers Fund, a Rockefeller family foundation, administers and maintains it and uses it for its programs and artist residencies.

name: National Heroes' Acre (Harare)
funding: Zimbabwe's government commissioned it from North Korean builders in 1981 and it opened in 1982. The Department of Museums and National Monuments runs it.
